title: How to add services to your MyServiceNSW Account
summary: This page explains how to add and apply for various NSW Government services using your MyServiceNSW Account.
what_you_need: Services you already have (e.g., a driver licence, which you can add by confirming details).
Services you would like to apply for.
A MyServiceNSW Account to connect you online with NSW Government services.

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Select the service you would like to add or apply for.
Follow the prompts to add your service.

faqs.q: How do I add services to my MyServiceNSW Account?
faqs.a: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account, go to 'Add services', select the service you want, and follow the prompts to add it.

faqs.q: Do I need to do anything myself when adding services?
faqs.a: Yes, for security and privacy reasons, you must choose which services you want to add and confirm your details yourself. Service NSW cannot do this for you.

faqs.q: Where can I log in to my MyServiceNSW Account?
faqs.a: You can log in to your MyServiceNSW Account here: https://account.service.nsw.gov.au/api/auth/login
